subject: BridgeWave discovery — alignment & action orchestration
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Shea <liam.oshea@bridgewave.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@bridgewave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 14:03:00 -0400
Subject: BridgeWave discovery — recap + proposed action orchestration

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our 45-minute discovery so we have shared clarity and a proposed orchestration of next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain / goals you shared:
- Ingest latency spikes during peak trading windows causing downstream model staleness (~2–5x variance in ingestion latency).
- Cost sensitivity for production inference — target is < $0.05 per 1k tokens for the user-facing Assistant feature.
- Security/compliance: must run in customer-dedicated VPC with KMS-backed keys; SOC 2 evidence required for procurement.

Success metrics if this project succeeds:
- 50% reduction in 99th percentile latency for the inference pipeline
- Unit cost at or below your target within the first 6 weeks of pilot
- Pilot demonstration to hold under your security controls (VPC, KMS) with CSAT >= 8/10

Draft mutual action plan (high level) — please confirm owners and dates:
1) Pilot scope & access (Owner: Priya D., Redwood AE: Jasmine) — target: 2027-09-20 
   - Deliverables: sample dataset + network reachability test, signed pilot SOW stub
2) Security validation (Owner: Procurement / Security at BridgeWave) — target: 2027-09-27
   - Deliverables: SOC2 summary, architecture diagram, KMS integration notes
3) Pilot run (Owner: BridgeWave Engineering + Redwood CSM: Monica) — target: 2027-10-11
   - Deliverables: 2-week load test, latency/cost dashboard, quality checklists
4) Decision & commercial terms (Owner: BridgeWave Procurement) — target: 2027-10-25
   - Deliverables: procurement PO or contract signature, committed throughput

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Priya / Liam: confirm pilot SOW owners and whether procurement should be looped in now (procurement@bridgewave.com?).
- BridgeWave: share the minimal data access and a sample of the ingestion pattern by 2027-09-14 so we can size the pilot cluster.
- Redwood: we will share a one-page pilot SOW + the MAP PDF (attached) by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: bridgewave_rfi.xlsx (security/RFI answers in progress) — we will add SOC2 artifacts next version.

Links: HubSpot record + shared MAP doc included below.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short follow-up if that helps.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0126

--

From: Liam O'Shea <liam.oshea@bridgewave.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@bridgewave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, procurement@bridgewave.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 15:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: BridgeWave discovery — recap + proposed action orchestration

Thanks Jasmine — useful summary. A few notes from our side: 

- Confirming procurement should be looped in now. I copied procurement@bridgewave.com; our procurement lead is Tarek Khan (they'll send an onboarding checklist).
- Timeline: 2027-10-25 decision date is our target but we may accelerate to mid-October if pilot proves out quickly.
- For sizing: we'll likely need pricing for an initial pilot (3 nodes) and a production baseline (5 nodes) — can you give ballpark OPEX ranges?
- SOC2 docs are required: we need at least the SOC2 Type II report PDF and a contact for security questions.

Also — we'll need a short demo for our infrastructure leads (30 min) the week of 9/13; can Redwood run a 30-minute technical walkthrough and answer KMS/VPC questions?

I'll get you the ingestion sample by 9/14. Priya, can your team review the MAP dates and owners?

Cheers,
Liam
Head of Platform Engineering | BridgeWave
liam.oshea@bridgewave.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 17:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: BridgeWave discovery — recap + proposed action orchestration

Internal note — looping in pricing context before we respond to Liam's sizing question:

- Pilot (3 nodes, shared): estimated ~$2.4k–$3.2k / week (GPU-backed, auto-burst off).
- Production (5 nodes, dedicated): estimated $11k–$14k / month depending on KV cache usage and quantization profile.
- Need to confirm token throughput assumptions; ask: what are average request sizes and concurrent requests during peak windows?

I'll draft a concise pricing appendix to attach to the pilot SOW. Monica — can you prepare a short runbook template for the 2-week pilot so we can propose the load test plan by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Shea <liam.oshea@bridgewave.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@bridgewave.com>, procurement@bridgewave.com

Subject: BridgeWave — Mutual Action Plan (v1) + attachments

Liam / Priya / Procurement team —

Per our thread, attached is MAP v1 (BridgeWave_MAP_v1.pdf) and a short pilot SOW stub. I embedded the milestone table below for visibility — please review and suggest edits inline on the shared Drive doc.

Mutual Action Plan (v1) — milestones, owners, decision gates

| Milestone | Owner (BridgeWave) | Owner (Redwood) | Target date | Decision gate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pilot SOW signed | Priya Desai | Jasmine Liu | 2027-09-20 | SOW approved by BridgeWave legal/procurement |
| Security validation (SOC2, network) | Tarek Khan / Procurement | Redwood Security | 2027-09-27 | SOC2 summary accepted + network test green |
| Pilot run & load test | BridgeWave Eng | Monica Patel | 2027-10-11 | Latency & cost targets met in staging |
| Commercial decision | Procurement | Ben Carter | 2027-10-25 | PO or contract signature |

(Inline edits recommended on: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cBridgeWaveMAP)

Attachments included: BridgeWave_MAP_v1.pdf, SLA-exception-notes.docx, bridgewave_rfi.xlsx (updated).

Action items I will take this week:
- Share one-page pilot SOW with pricing appendix (Ben) by 2027-09-08 EOD.
- Schedule technical walkthrough for 9/14 (30-min) — confirm team availability and invite.
- Deliver SOC2 summary + security contact info to procurement@bridgewave.com by 2027-09-09.

Please reply to confirm owners/dates or suggest changes. If acceptable, Priya — can you reply with the procurement contact and your internal approver list so we have names for the MAP?

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the clear MAP. A couple of adjustments from procurement/security: 

- Decision date: procurement would like the commercial decision moved up to 2027-10-18 if pilot metrics are favorable — that is their preferred target.
- Please include our VP of Engineering (Anika Rao <anika.rao@bridgewave.com>) as an approver on the pilot SOW.
- We need SOC2 Type II PDF and a security contact (name + phone) before the network test. Can you add those to the MAP attachments?

Procurement contact: Tarek Khan <tarek.khan@bridgewave.com> (procurement@bridgewave.com is a monitored inbox; Tarek will send formal onboarding checklist).

Also — can Redwood draft a 1-page pilot Statement of Work that includes acceptance criteria for the load test (latency percentiles and token cost targets)? If you can share that by 2027-09-09 EOD, we'll route internally.

Thanks — Priya
Director, Strategic Procurement | BridgeWave
